svg.desc: Source artwork and diagram marks with original positioned text. F 1 Generation Meiosis Metaphase I Anaphase I Metaphase II All F 1 plants produce yellow-round seeds ( YyRr ). LAW OF SEGREGATION The two alleles for each gene separate. LAW OF INDEPENDENT ASSORTMENT Alleles of genes on non-homologous chromosomes assort independently.
